KillCRAN

collapse

CRAN 2.1.8

collapse 2.1.8 is complete. All 382 exports and the datasets wlddev and GGDC10S are checked. Missing values are skipped by default, and an all-missing group stays missing unless fill is set. A grouped lag reads the row n places back after the group has been seen n times. Non-standard evaluation is a string or a callable. A time index raises CollapseError. Several factors are centered by alternating projections and were not compared with fixest. qDT and qTBL are data frames. na_insert writes the first floor(n * prop) rows. nthreads is accepted and ignored. On these small cases Python is slower than collapse's C.
